_comment: Pipeline registry for the stable-diffusion.cpp (sd-server) engine -- the sdcpp analog of workflow_graphs/models.json. Keyed by the SAME active_model string a media/image.yaml prefer[] entry uses with engine: sdcpp, so config/models.py::_check_media_tier can cross-check each declared capability against a `tools` entry here (via sdcpp_pipelines.tools_for). Paths are RELATIVE to the container's models mount (models_dir, default /comfyui-models -- the same read-only tree comfyui uses; NOT bare /models, which is already claimed globally for the LLM checkpoint tree -- reusing it made Docker refuse the container outright with 'Duplicate mount point: /models', found live 2026-09-15). Unlike ComfyUI, sd.cpp selects its weights at SERVER START (no per-request checkpoint swap), so which pipeline is resident is a launch decision: engines/sdcpp.py::SdcppAdapter.render_args reads diffusion_model/vae/text_encoder/lora_model_dir from the entry named by the resident active_model. The per-verb blocks under `tools` carry the SAMPLING recipe the MCP sends to POST /sdcpp/v1/img_gen. custom_sigmas is the fal/FLUX.2-dev-Turbo published pre-shifted 8-step schedule -- supplied for generate (t2i), OMITTED (null) for stylize/edit because sd.cpp derives its own strength-based schedule for img2img and forcing the t2i sigmas onto it fights that derivation and ghosted the 1024^2/0.75 stylize into a double exposure (README trap 14). A verb whose block is absent makes the config loader reject that capability for this model.

flux2-dev-turbo-sdcpp.label: Flux.2 dev -- fp8mixed base + fal FLUX.2-dev-Turbo LoRA, 8-step, on the Strix Halo iGPU via stable-diffusion.cpp HIPBLAS (generate + stylize + edit)
